specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready seamless albedo texture for a cozy toy-town mobile game, matching a warm garden town with cream stone paths, soft dark roads and lush farm-style grass. Generate a single square 1024x1024 image, a perfectly orthographic flat top-down material swatch covering the entire image edge to edge. No scene, no perspective, no objects, no border, no labels, no UI. Lighting is completely diffuse and even, no directional shadows, no ambient-occlusion vignette, no highlight hotspot, no painted depth bevel. Tile must repeat seamlessly on all four edges, same color/value at every edge. Restrained hand-painted stylization with broad quiet color variation and legible soft material shapes, not photoreal scanned noise. Opaque. Material: soft clean medium-dark neutral slate asphalt with a very slight warm blue-gray cast, value near #737981. Very fine sparse rounded aggregate blended into broad matte areas, subtly worn lighter patches with exceptionally low contrast. It covers a 6x6 world-unit road square. No lane markings, no arrows, no zebra crossing, no curbs, no cracks, no potholes, no oil spills, no moss, no tire tracks. Markings are separate game geometry; this texture must work rotated through any junction. The surface should read as quiet painted asphalt from an isometric camera, not gravel or chalk.

Material: warm pale honey-beige limestone sidewalk pavers, near #d7c396, a gentle cream-and-sand palette, neither bright white nor orange. A regular running-bond grid of softly rectangular small paving stones, approximately eight stones across and twelve courses high in the square. Narrow low-contrast muted taupe joints, edges slightly irregular and softened by hand painting, subtly varied pale stone faces. Flat albedo, no directional relief/shadows. No grass, flowers, weeds, large cracks, dirty blobs, border trim or decorative motif.
